collection.title: Citroen ZX 1991 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen ZX 1991 to 1997 model requires a 22" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this ZX, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
